server.name: marxel-shortlist-studio
server.title: Marxel
server.description: Compare user-supplied CVs against confirmed hiring criteria with verbatim evidence quotes, prepare interview questions, and save a selected review to the recruiter's Marxel applicant tracking workspace.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Use Marxel to review candidates whose CVs the recruiter supplies in this conversation.
Review flow: collect the hiring brief and up to 5 CVs, call confirm_criteria with proposed criteria, then call create_review_workspace with only the criteria it returns as confirmed and exact verbatim quotes from each CV.
Use open_shortlist or compare_candidates only for the labelled fictional sample.
To save a review, call list_marxel_organizations, let the user choose an organisation, get explicit confirmation, then call save_to_marxel with a new UUID idempotencyKey; reuse that key for retries and get_marxel_save_status.
Never rank candidates, assign Screening Buckets, or make hire or reject decisions; humans review the evidence.

tool.name: create_review_workspace
tool.title: Create Marxel review workspace
tool.description: Build a candidate comparison and interview-question workspace from user-supplied CVs. Before calling: call confirm_criteria and use exactly the criteria it returns as confirmed, and ask the user to confirm the candidate batch; a prior confirmation does not cover a changed set. Each workspace supports at most 5 candidates and 8 criteria. With more than 5 CVs, ask the user to choose a batch of up to 5 and name the deferred candidates; never silently omit candidates or criteria. If confirming criteria in chat and there are more than 8, propose a reduced or consolidated set for the user to confirm. Distinguish explicit requirements from responsibilities and desirable experience: use Responsibility for role duties, and do not make them Must-have without the user's agreement or relabel them Nice-to-have. Quote exactly and verbatim from each candidate's sourceText; use match only when the quote supports the full criterion, and partial when it covers only part. Do not rank candidates, assign Screening Buckets, or make hire or reject decisions. To correct an assessment, call this tool again with the corrected status, all original source text, and the same criteria and candidate batch before claiming the workspace is updated; if that fails, say the visible workspace still shows the previous assessment. The latest successful workspace replaces earlier ones for discussion and export. Returns the brief, each candidate's status, quote, source and interview question per criterion, and any unreadable CVs. A quote not found verbatim fails the call. Stores nothing and changes no Marxel records; save_to_marxel imports a review.

tool.name: confirm_criteria
tool.title: Confirm hiring criteria
tool.description: Ask the recruiter to confirm the job-related criteria before any evidence is extracted. Propose up to 12 criteria derived from the hiring brief, with Must-have only for explicit requirements, Responsibility for role duties and Nice-to-have for desirable experience. Where the client supports forms, the recruiter reviews them in a form and keeps at most 8; otherwise confirm them in chat. Returns a state of confirmed with the recruiter's kept criteria and weights, not_confirmed when the form was closed, or confirm_in_chat with the proposed criteria when forms are unavailable. Use only the criteria this tool returns as confirmed, and do not create a workspace when it reports they were not confirmed.
